entries.test: Public evidence of whether GPT-5 enables interstellar spacecraft or gives a country a military advantage that opponents cannot overcome.
entries.note: The separate reference to 2024 does not supply a deadline for both claims extracted here.
“A safe bet” presents this outcome as probable rather than unqualified.

entries.test: Marcus's published predictions about GPT-4 compared with documented GPT-4 performance and failures available by the post's publication.
entries.note: A single demonstrably incorrect prediction would refute the universal assertion.

entries.test: Reproducible evaluations showing whether standalone GPT models can reliably check facts and whether fabrication remains characteristic of their outputs.
entries.note: This combines historical and present assertions with an unlimited future claim. The standalone-model qualification comes from the preceding sentences.

entries.test: Public technical descriptions and evaluations of any AI that achieves the described scientific and technological transformation, establishing whether LLMs contribute only marginally or centrally.
entries.note: The possibility concerns whether transformative AI arrives; the prediction about LLMs' role if it does is firm.
The distinction between text manipulation and “real understanding” supplies no shared test for the asserted misunderstanding and its causal role.

entries.test: Public evaluations or deployments demonstrating GPT's reliability in data processing, autonomous driving, and tracking airborne military forces.
entries.note: The statement combines a present limitation with explicit forecasts about driving and military tracking.
The extracted bundle includes possible computational costs and uncertainty about appropriate trust. Its narrower assertions about existing summarization performance could be tested separately.

entries.test: Public planning benchmarks and representative military-task evaluations testing whether GPT's planning failures prevent successful performance across almost all such scenarios.
entries.note: Marcus adopts the planning claim in his own prose before quoting Kambhampati. “That's curtains” conveys a substantive claim of operational failure.

entries.test: Public release records and documented developments through Q4 2023 showing whether GPT-5 produced the described transformation for China or the US.
entries.note: In context, “fantasy” dismisses a concrete dated outcome rather than merely assigning it a probability.
“Wins the AI war” has no shared endpoint: technical leadership, economic dominance, and military supremacy could yield different verdicts.
